about: Milestone N2 of ADR 0012, engine waits and time: the catalogue cases of FX-23 to FX-29, recorded on the CE oracle by the fixtures below, which N2 wrote and whose runs its exit gate runs on windmill-lite; each case is recorded by a run or deferred with a milestone and a reason. FX-24/d and /e need a loop and gate NI; FX-24/g's in-process executor is later; the delays of FX-26/c to /e are hours long, beyond what a recording waits for, and the walker does not capture a queued job's scheduled time, so N2's unit tests check them on the recording clock (internal/engine, TestRetryDelay and TestEngineRetryDelays). TestRecordingBatches enforces it.
